crossRefs.note: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and…
The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy…

translations.web: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
translations.bsb: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, since the famine that follows it will be so severe.
translations.kjv: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
translations.asv: and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine which followeth; for it shall be very grievous.
